# Pratik Bajoria — AI Implementation for Business

> Pratik Bajoria is a Chartered Accountant and ex-Big 4 AI implementation consultant helping companies create measurable P&L impact. Consulting entity is primary; Findost is product proof.

## Primary services

- AI Opportunity Audit: workflow mapping, use-case scoring and a prioritised 90-day roadmap.
- Workflow Automation: production systems, document agents, WhatsApp/email automation and business-system integrations.
- Finance & Compliance AI: reconciliation, month-end close, GST, TDS, MIS and audit-ready controls.
- Team Enablement: workshops, prompt libraries, SOPs and AI usage policy.
- Fractional AI Leadership: roadmap ownership, governance, vendor selection and reporting.
- AI Product Advisory: architecture, model choices, pricing and go-to-market for AI products.

## Process

Diagnose → Prioritise → Build → Embed.

## About

Pratik works from India with business leaders in India, the United States, the United Kingdom and globally. He is also the founder of Findost, an AI-powered wealth management platform (proof of shipping AI in a regulated domain — consulting remains the primary commercial entity on this site).

## Key FAQ

- **What is AI implementation?** Building and deploying AI systems that solve real business problems and deliver measurable P&L impact.
- **How does the first engagement work?** A structured AI Opportunity Audit: map workflows, score use cases on impact and risk, and produce a prioritised 90-day roadmap. Details: https://pratikbajoria.com/audit
- **Which sectors does Pratik serve?** Financial services, accounting and professional services, manufacturing and distribution, retail and e-commerce, healthcare, real estate, legal and compliance, and SaaS and technology.
- **How is sensitive data handled?** Architecture, retention and access controls are scoped to client policies; sensitive work can use redaction, private deployments and audit trails.
- **How do I get in touch?** Book a discovery call, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, or email hello@pratikbajoria.com — replies within one business day.

## Editorial policy

Insights are practical, implementation-focused and may contain disclosed affiliate links. Affiliate recommendations are editorially independent. Finance and markets content is educational and does not constitute financial, investment or legal advice.

## Editorial pillars

- AI for Business: implementation, automation, governance and measurable operating impact.
- Finance & Markets: financial analysis, controls and decision-making education; not investment advice.
- Business Systems: dashboards, planning, CRM, workflow design and operating cadence.
- Tool Reviews & Comparisons: practical evaluation of business software, AI tools and automation platforms.
- CA Insights: accounting, compliance, controls and finance transformation explained for operators.
